assembly_notes: Six independent structural slots and no multiplicity: a compass has exactly two legs. head_style provides the shared pivot axis and a crown seat; leg_style consumes the pivot and re-publishes a station frame and a tip frame; adjuster_style consumes the station frame (or grows its own spine off the head), and the two tip slots consume the tip frame. All 5 x 4 x 8 x 5 x 2 x 3 = 4800 combinations build with no compatibility gate. Because the two legs' local frames are mirrored by their axis mates, the one world-side front hardware plane sits at a different local depth on each leg; every feature placed there is fused back to its leg by a derived standoff boss, which is what keeps each leg one connected body. Cross-leg hardware (cross screw guide jaws, rack teeth, pawl tooth) is deliberately thin so that any interference as a leg swings stays far below the 5 mm penetration budget. Every rotational joint is solved by mate_axes and registered with register_interface_mate. The collet publishes its bore as a plane interface with a surface_relation: the needle cartridge is an insert driven through that mouth, so it is checked at FULL insertion with expect_footprint_within plus expect_normal_band(minimum_protrusion=0.0080) — a cartridge that swallowed its own point would otherwise pass a rest-pose check.

derived.expression: the two legs sit at y = -+leg_offset_y_m on one pin of length 2*leg_offset_y_m + 0.0026
derived.name: hinge_stack_y_m
derived.rationale: the pin and its caps must span whatever plate thickness the leg candidate uses

derived.name: leg_splay_rad
derived.rationale: the rest splay is solved by the axis mate, not by a hand-written origin

derived.expression: world y = -(leg_offset_y_m + leg_thickness_m/2 + 0.0035); each leg converts it into its own frame and grows a standoff boss to reach it
derived.name: front_plane_y_m
derived.rationale: both legs and the head must present their adjuster hardware on one plane

derived.expression: spanning adjusters size their shaft from tip_span_m; head-mounted adjusters size their spine from station_m
derived.name: adjuster_span_m
derived.rationale: the adjuster must reach across whatever opening the legs are set to

derived.expression: tip_z = -leg_length_m on a one-piece leg and -(leg_length_m - knee_m) in the lower section of a folding leg
derived.name: tip_z_m
derived.rationale: the tip hardware follows whichever part actually carries the tip

derived.expression: crown_z is each head candidate's real top; the crown boss is fused into the head so a fixed cap, a spinning grip or a bounded handle all seat on it
derived.name: crown_z_m
derived.rationale: the handle must sit on real head geometry, not on a nominal height

surface_relation.motion_expression: inserting q in [0, 0.0060] drives the cartridge up into the bore; at q = 0.0060 the needle tip still protrudes 0.010 m >= 0.0080 m past the mouth. Both projections name their element, because a whole-part AABB is inflated by the leg's own tilt at preflight fidelity
surface_relation.normal_band_expression: measured out of the mouth, the needle_point element occupies [-0.004, +0.010] at full insertion; the allowed band is [-0.0060, +0.0120]
surface_relation.opening_expression: the cartridge_shoulder element is 0.0025 m in radius against a 0.0032 m collet bore, so the widest section passes the mouth with 0.0007 m to spare
surface_relation.required_author_check: category_anchor: the needle cartridge keeps its point proud of the collet
